# Creative Bandit

> A two-person studio in Indianapolis. We are the white-label build team behind
> WordPress agencies: full-stack development and AI automation from Adam Speer,
> design and motion from Katlyn. Agencies bring us the work their clients are
> asking for and we ship it under their name.

## What we do

- [Services](https://creativebandit.studio/services/): the full list, with what each engagement covers.
- [WordPress development](https://creativebandit.studio/services/wordpress/): headless builds, migrations, plugin and theme work, and maintenance for agency clients.
- [Agent Ops](https://creativebandit.studio/services/agent-ops/): ongoing WordPress security, updates, and monitoring across an agency's portfolio.
- [Blog](https://creativebandit.studio/blog/): build notes from the sites we run, with first-party data on search, AI crawlers, and product data.
- [AI readiness scan](https://creativebandit.studio/scan/): a free scan reporting whether AI crawlers can reach and read a site, covering robots.txt, CDN-level blocks, structured data, and metadata.

## Work

- [Portfolio](https://creativebandit.studio/work/): production projects with the stack and the measurable result for each, across fintech, healthcare, e-commerce, and enterprise software.
- [HomeWaterPure case study](https://creativebandit.studio/work/homewaterpure/): a water softener and filter guide where every product links to the source of its specs.
- [Invoice for Trades case study](https://creativebandit.studio/work/invoice-for-trades/): a free, no-signup invoice generator with browser-side PDFs and 27 trade pages.
- [RecycleOldTech case study](https://creativebandit.studio/work/recycleoldtech/): a programmatic directory of certified electronics recyclers.
- [eBikeLocal case study](https://creativebandit.studio/work/ebikelocal/): an e-bike shop directory built from brand dealer locators and Google Places data.
- [DowntownDry case study](https://creativebandit.studio/work/downtowndry/): an alcohol-free venue directory verified by Google APIs and Gemini.
- [Yield to Freedom case study](https://creativebandit.studio/work/yield-to-freedom/): an income ETF research platform that grades funds from A to D.
- [Home Power Ready case study](https://creativebandit.studio/work/home-power-ready/): a standby generator and battery backup directory with two calculators.
